ASK_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Use the question tool to collect each required field
CROSS_REVIEW_CONFIG: The tool reads `.opencode/cross-review.json` (project) first and uses it exclusively when present, without reading `~/.config/opencode/cross-review.json` (global); only when the project config is absent does it fall back to the global config. A `reviewers` array assigns each reviewer its own optional `focus`; `reviewModels` values are assigned round-robin across the reviewer count. An optional `reviewerTimeoutMs` (5000-3600000, default 600000) sets the per-session deadline for reviewers and the explicit judge; an explicit `--reviewer-timeout-ms` flag overrides it. An optional `gitcodeCli` absolute path locates gitcode-cli for GitCode targets only.
CROSS_REVIEW_ORCHESTRATION: Call `cross_review_start` once with the normalized arguments and retain its `runID`. The start result includes a `config` resolution block (`sources` plus resolved paths) and a `warning` when the project config was missing or a non-PR parent-judged start omitted `context`; use those fields instead of guessing whether the project file loaded. Poll with `cross_review_status`, which waits on the server side for reviewer progress or up to `waitMs` (default 30s) before returning, eliminating client-side busy-waiting; each call reconciles child sessions, detects reviewer deadlines, and fills available concurrency slots. Never insert a client-side `sleep` between status calls. An overdue session enters `timeout_pending` without being aborted or releasing its concurrency slot, and status returns `actionRequired`. Never resolve it automatically, and never pre-send `timeoutAction` on ordinary polls: ask the user whether to preserve the session or abort it, then call `cross_review_status` once with `timeoutAction: "preserve"` or `timeoutAction: "abort"`. A stray `timeoutAction` while nothing is pending is ignored with a warning. Preserving keeps the same session running, extends its deadline by one configured timeout period, and allows its eventual output into quorum; aborting retains the previous terminal `timed_out` behavior. The default status result is compact (counts plus a per-reviewer `summary`) and omits the config block; request `detail` or `includeOutputs` only when full fields are needed, since `finalize` returns the complete candidates anyway. Call `cross_review_finalize` only after reviewers become terminal (`readyToFinalize: true`). The tool rejects finalize while gathering, reviewers, or the judge are still active. If it starts an explicit judge, poll status until the judge is terminal and finalize again. Use `cross_review_cancel` for cancellation. Do not call the legacy blocking `cross_review` tool.
MODEL_NAMING: Use exact OpenCode `provider/model` identifiers from `opencode models`; malformed, disconnected, or unavailable models are errors.
RESOLVE_AMBIGUITY: Resolve ambiguity with the question tool
